01 — About me

Developer first, student always

I am Hammad Khan, a web developer based in Peshawar, Pakistan. I work in full-stack development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, PHP and MySQL, and I enjoy turning ideas into clean, responsive and practical websites.

Rather than only studying theory, I build small, complete web projects end to end — database schema, server-side logic with PHP and PDO, and a polished Bootstrap front end — then publish the code on GitHub and share what I learned. I am currently shipping new projects twice a day to sharpen my skills.

My goal is to help local businesses get online with websites that are fast, affordable and easy to manage, while growing toward larger full-stack work.

06 — FAQ

Questions, answered quickly

The things visitors ask most before starting a project with me.

What kind of websites and apps can you build?

Business and portfolio websites, landing pages, and data-driven web apps such as task managers and expense trackers. Everything is built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, PHP and MySQL, and works properly on phones and desktops.

How do we start a project?

Send me a message through the contact form below or by email with what you need. We agree the pages, features and timeline first, then I build it and share progress as it comes together.

Do you work remotely?

Yes. I am based in Peshawar, Pakistan and work remotely, so we can handle everything over email and online calls, wherever you are.

Can I see your code before hiring you?

Yes, all of it is public. My projects, including TaskFlow and SpendTrack, are on GitHub with full source code, linked from the Projects section above.
